source_epoch_vs_DC_epoch: Track last supplied source epoch independently of the DC innovation epoch. Cut when supplied source epoch changes to a new valid boundary, not simply when it differs from the DC innovation epoch. Innovation must not make unchanged source epoch0 reset every subsequent frame.
metadata: Optional source epoch values must be nondecreasing integers0<=epoch_i<=i and must originate from the unchanged source-only pilot/controls. Optional exposure values must be positive finite. Present exposure changes use exact supplied-value comparison; absence remains unknown. Invalid metadata clears history and last-valid metadata reference; next valid frame starts fresh.
invalid_target_representation: Emit target_valid=false and targetRGB=[null,null,null] in JSON diagnostics for invalid/unknown targets. A future numerical API may use NaN placeholders but the application must branch on valid before reading target. Invalid source bits are not rewritten; application returns exact existing baseline frame, unless baseline itself invalid raises.
history_initialization: Current is appended only after prior comparison and possible cut. For the next call retain63 prior means. First8 source means populate the DC history despite frozen pilot inactive warmup; application remains exact baseline when pilot inactive. New target has no separate activation switch.
nominal_SE: AllRGB share one event/cut but sigma/q are perchannel. The threshold tests abs RGB mean differences directly against3sqrt(q_current+sum(q_past)/m^2). No empirical sample-variance, observed truth, baseline noise floor, gain/phase, scene name or native null enters the decision.
complex_noise_selection: Select rFFT x indices1..(wROI/2-1) when even,1..floor(wROI/2) when odd; all y. No Nyquist/DC boundary column and no per-frame spectral support selection.
application_operator: This is a fixed uniform RGB offset, so before FP32 rounding and atomic invalidpixel fallback its nonDC component equals the unchanged candidate. That algebra does not imply existing weak/phase failures pass, and actual fallback masks/rounding remain measurable.
cost: One additional current interior rFFT and bounded64x3 means/variances per frame; no allhistory image storage, covariance matrices, optimizers or parameter sweeps. CPU only until root technical review.
evaluation_units: Source target/Pproxy has13+22 coverage; actual postcompose offline has exactly6 matching measured harmonic scenes. Do not promote proxy acceptance to native acceptance or use an old response measured for another P.
